title: 第15章 师姐 师弟师姐不允许任何人伤害你第16章 师姐师弟以身相许
content_zh:
“许师弟，要不你还是补偿补偿我吧？”
回到洞府的宋真罗师兄越想越不对劲，自己差点死在外面，最后，拿到那么一点灵药，卖出去了也没多少钱，算来算去，还不如自己在门派赚得多。
随便收取一点保护费，都比出门赚得多，心里不爽的他，忍耐了好些天，终于忍不住了，上门对质。
不多拿一点报酬，那口气顺不了。
“宋师兄，要灵石没有，要命有一条。”
许君白抬头挺胸，来吧，你来杀我。
那么一瞬间，宋真罗师兄真的想动手。
若不是大公猪翻动了身躯，那双眼眸扫了他一眼，让他压力剧增，似乎他动手的那一刻，死的人很可能是他，而不是眼前的许君白师弟。
举起的手放下来，宋真罗师兄哽咽一口，传闻灵药峰很危险，最危险的不是许君白，而是他饲养的那些宠物，防不胜防，你怎么死的都不知道。
死去的那些弟子，可都是不明不白，要么呢，被压下来，要么就是被他宋真罗师兄给摆平了。
其次呢，还有师兄师姐帮他摆平，总而言之，许君白依旧活得好好的，得罪他，不明智。
“许师弟，你这样子可就是耍赖咯，我为了你付出了那么多，差点死在外面，你怎么能？”
无法动粗，只能够动之以情，晓之以理。
宋真罗能屈能伸，为了灵石，他可以低头。
“宋师兄，不是师弟不给你，而是师弟我也亏啊，你知道那个任务的奖励是什么吗？”
“是什么？”
许君白把《养猪三百六十五式》递过去，宋真罗师兄一看，沉默了。
不信邪的他，翻看了几页，看了一刻钟。
还是不信邪，他继续翻看，整本书都看完了，一无所获。
不服气的宋师兄，坐下来，开始了研习，两个时辰过去了。

许君白轻声问一句：“宋师兄，可研究出来了吗？”
宋真罗合上书本，还给许君白。
“许师弟，到底是谁给你的任务。”
他生气了，哪个混蛋颁布的任务，坑了他不要紧，坑了许师弟，那就是和他作对。
这件事情，不能就这么算了，以后他宋真罗还怎么在白云派混下去。
事关尊严和面子，他不能够算数。
“宋师兄，师弟劝你还是不要去找他麻烦了，你不是他的对手，去到了也是送死。”
“许师弟，你莫要担心，有师兄在，整个白云派没几个人能够欺负你。”
宋真罗师兄拍着胸口，义薄云天道：“许师弟，你告诉师兄，师兄帮你算账，岂有此理，欺负我可以，欺负我兄弟不行，谁不知道你是我罩着的。”
“正所谓打狗也要看主人，他欺负你，摆明了不把我放在眼里，师弟，你莫要拦着我，师兄我弄死他。”
许君白抱着手，冷冷看着宋真罗师兄，你这是拐着弯骂我。
再说了，我也没拉着你。
“咳咳，宋师兄，那个人就在上面，你去吧。”
宋真罗还想要放下狠话，一看，是白梧山山顶。
立刻傻眼了。
“师弟，你是说？”
“咕噜。”
哽咽声很大，许君白嘲笑道：“宋师兄，去吧，我师父很欢迎你去找他的麻烦，真的，不用给我面子，狠狠揍他。”
“你要是觉得没有武器，师弟这里正好有一些武器，不知道宋师兄？”
“宋师兄，你别跑啊。”

“喂，师兄，慢点走，前面有屎。”
“噗通。”
宋真罗师兄掉坑里了。
那个坑，乃是许君白用来沤肥的。
content_en:
"Junior Brother Xu, why don't you make it up to me?"
When Senior Brother Song Zhenluo returned to the cave, the more he thought about it, the more something was wrong. He almost died outside. In the end, he got such a small amount of elixir, but it didn't cost much to sell it. After all, it was better to earn more in the sect.
Any amount of protection money he collected was more than what he could earn from going out. Feeling unhappy, he endured it for several days, and finally couldn't bear it any longer and came to confront her.
If you don't get a little more reward, you won't be able to speak well.
"Senior Brother Song, it's important not to have a spiritual stone, but to have one."
Xu Junbai raised his head and chest, come on, kill me.
At that moment, Senior Brother Song Zhenluo really wanted to take action.
If the big boar hadn't turned its body and glanced at him with those eyes, his pressure increased dramatically. It seemed that the moment he took action, it was likely that he would be the one who died, not Junior Brother Xu Junbai in front of him.
Putting down his raised hand, Senior Brother Song Zhenluo choked up. Rumor has it that Spiritual Medicine Peak is very dangerous. The most dangerous thing is not Xu Junbai, but the pets he raises. They are impossible to guard against and you don't even know how you died.
Those disciples who died were all unknown, either they were suppressed or they were dealt with by his senior brother Song Zhenluo.
Secondly, there are senior brothers and sisters to help him settle things. All in all, Xu Junbai is still living well. It would be unwise to offend him.
"Junior Brother Xu, you are acting like this. I have sacrificed so much for you and almost died outside. How could you do that?"
You can't use force, you can only use emotion and reason.
Song Zhenluo can bend and stretch, and he can bow his head for the spirit stone.
"Senior Brother Song, it's not that Junior Brother doesn't give it to you, but Junior Brother, I'm also at a loss. Do you know what the reward for that mission is?"
"What is it?"
Xu Junbai handed over "Three Hundred and Sixty-five Styles of Raising Pigs". Senior Brother Song Zhenluo looked at it and fell silent.
Not believing in evil, he flipped through a few pages and read for a quarter of an hour.
Still not convinced, he continued to read and read the entire book without finding anything.
Unconvinced, Senior Brother Song sat down and started studying. Two hours passed.
Xu Junbai asked softly: "Senior Brother Song, have you finished the research?"
Song Zhenluo closed the book and returned it to Xu Junbai.
"Junior Brother Xu, who gave you this mission?"
He was angry. It didn't matter which bastard issued the mission. It didn't matter if he was cheated. If he was cheated on Junior Brother Xu, he was going against him.
We can't just let this matter go. How will Song Zhenluo continue to hang out in the Baiyun Sect in the future?
When it comes to dignity and face, he can't count.
"Senior Brother Song, I advise you not to trouble him. You are no match for him. If you do, you will die."
"Junior Brother Xu, don't worry. As long as Senior Brother is here, few people in the entire Baiyun Sect can bully you."
Senior brother Song Zhenluo patted his chest and Yi Bo Yuntian said: "Junior brother Xu, tell me that my brother will help you settle the score. How unreasonable. It's okay to bully me, but not my brother. Who doesn't know that I'm protecting you."
"As the saying goes, beating a dog depends on its owner. He bullied you and made it clear that he doesn't take me seriously. Junior Brother, don't stop me. Senior Brother, I will kill him."
Xu Junbai folded his hands and looked at Senior Brother Song Zhenluo coldly, "You are cursing me in a roundabout way."
Besides, I'm not holding you back.
"Ahem, Senior Brother Song, that person is up there, go ahead."
Song Zhenluo still wanted to put down his harsh words, but when he saw it, it was the top of Baiwu Mountain.
I was immediately dumbfounded.
"Junior brother, what do you mean?"
"Gulu."
Choking loudly, Xu Junbai laughed and said: "Senior Brother Song, go ahead. My master welcomes you to trouble him. Really, you don't need to give me face and beat him up."
"If you think there are no weapons, Junior Brother happens to have some weapons here, don't you know Senior Brother Song?"
"Senior Brother Song, don't run away."
"Hey, senior brother, walk slowly, there is shit ahead."
"Plop."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo fell into a trap.
That pit,It was used by Xu Junbai for retting.
